topic: Dynamic slot duration release status update
summary_markdown: A discussion regarding the readiness and deployment of a dynamic slot duration feature. Initially, one participant confirmed that testing was complete and preparation for release was underway due to view complexities, estimating an online status within 1-2 hours. Another participant noted that the release had not yet been deployed. Later, the same participant confirmed that the feature had been released.
decisions: The dynamic slot duration feature has been released.
